These answers deliberately describe process and candidacy rather than outcomes, and make no efficacy or recovery-rate claims, because marketing claims for stem cell treatment attract FDA and FTC scrutiny. Have a clinician review this file before launch.

items.q: What conditions and therapies do you specialize in at One Light Medical?
items.a: We specialize in non-surgical regenerative medicine, focusing primarily on stem cell therapy for chronic joint pain, osteoarthritis, and tissue degeneration. We also provide complementary care including spinal decompression, red light therapy, SoftWave therapy, and IV therapy.

items.q: How does stem cell therapy work for joint pain?
items.a: Rather than masking pain, the aim is to support the repair processes your body already has. Cellular therapy places concentrated regenerative material into the area where the tissue is damaged, so the response happens at the site of the problem instead of throughout your system. Because a joint's condition, your health history, and your goals all shape what is appropriate, we begin with an examination and imaging review and then talk you through what the therapy can and cannot do in your particular case.

items.q: Are your regenerative therapies a good alternative to joint replacement surgery?
items.a: For some patients they are worth exploring first, because our approach is non-surgical and involves no lengthy recovery. Whether it suits you depends on how much healthy tissue and joint space remain, which we can only judge from an examination and your imaging. We will also be straight with you: where the damage is beyond what regenerative care can reach, we will say so and help you plan the next step rather than sell you a course of treatment.

items.q: Can I combine stem cell therapy with other treatments like Red Light or IV Therapy?
items.a: Yes, and they are commonly planned together. Our IV Hydration and Nutrient Therapy delivers vitamins, antioxidants and hydration directly into the bloodstream to support the internal foundation healing depends on, while red light therapy supports circulation and helps manage inflammation. Every plan is built for one person, so we combine only the therapies that earn a place in yours.

items.q: How do I know if I am a candidate for care at One Light Medical?
items.a: An examination and a conversation will tell us far more than any web page can. Most of our patients arrive with chronic joint pain, arthritis, disc or nerve trouble, or pain that has not responded to medication and injections. Book a consultation and we will review your history, examine you, and tell you plainly whether our therapies are likely to help you.
